<section class="cvs"><h2>Research Interests</h2>
<div class="ent"><span class="t">Stochastic optimization and sampling</span><span class="s">Markov chain Monte Carlo, Langevin algorithms, decentralized Bayesian inference, constrained sampling, high-dimensional probability.</span></div>
<div class="ent"><span class="t">Financial engineering</span><span class="s">Predictive modeling of time series with classical statistical and machine-learning models; derivative pricing; portfolio risk management.</span></div>
</section>
